name: I-ke-na-i ♥ Oshigoto
original_name: い・け・な・い♥お仕事
source:
Main character continues family business of a firm fulfilling any kinds of requests coming by email. This time a request comes from a woman who needs to ruin the omiai date prepared by her parents. Protagonist decides to hook up male partner with some girl to avert him from the girl in question.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公继承家族事业，经营一家通过电子邮件接受并完成各种委托的公司。这次的客户是一名女性，她希望破坏父母替自己安排的相亲。主人公决定撮合相亲男方与另一名女孩，以转移他对委托人的兴趣。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
